name: sprintable-codex
description: Sprintable channel + tools for Codex CLI — real-time Agent Gateway events via hooks, hosted MCP for tools.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to your Sprintable team in real time
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex CLI to a Sprintable team. A SessionStart hook boots a background listener on the Sprintable Agent Gateway SSE stream; a Stop hook injects queued team messages as new turns and posts responses back — no local MCP process, no polling loop to babysit. Tools (list/update stories, search docs, send chat messages, etc.) are exposed via a hosted MCP server, so there's nothing to clone or run yourself.
defaultPrompt: Check my Sprintable notifications and summarize anything that needs my attention.
List my assigned stories in Sprintable.
Reply to the latest message in my current Sprintable conversation.
